consequence.statement: Environments that had not enabled the AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats feature gate will find additional certificate output formats enabled after upgrading to cert-manager 1.18.0; environments that had already enabled the gate see no change.
consequence.remediation: No operator action required; verify that additional certificate output formats are produced and consumed as expected after upgrading.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 promotes the `AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats` feature to GA, making additional certificate output formats always enabled regardless of the previous feature gate setting.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for feature-gate behavior-changed
